stages.name: State engine
stages.what: Snapshot per instrument, < 400 tokens, no future data

stages.name: Policy engine
stages.what: Long / short / exit / stand aside by confidence

stages.name: Risk engine
stages.what: Sizing, leverage, stops, vetoes, kill switch

stages.name: Fallback ladder
stages.what: Code-only rules when Jev is down, alerts, drilled

stages.name: Paper trading + Step 8
stages.what: Two weeks, then calibration, baselines, fees

questions.ask: What market regime does this state describe right now?
What is the most likely price bias over the next hour?
The most recent price move is likely to continue over the next hour rather than reverse
The spread is abnormally wide compared with normal conditions for this instrument
How favorable is this state for opening a new directional position?
How urgently should an open position in this instrument be reduced or closed?

limits.name: Max Jev errors in a row
No new trades around major news

rungs.name: Healthy, low confidence
rungs.do: Stand aside until Jev is sure

rungs.name: Jev unavailable
rungs.do: Simple code-only rules at reduced size

rungs.name: Hard limit breached
rungs.do: Kill switch: everything closed, alert sent
